title: Early Stopping
seoDescription: Train a PyTorch model with validation monitoring and stop after the configured number of unimproved epochs.
description:
Track validation loss across training epochs and trigger early stopping when improvement halts for a designated patience window.

Early stopping prevents overfitting by halting optimization at peak generalization before model memorization takes over.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\Delta \mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{best}} - \mathcal{L}_t < \delta \implies \text{counter} \leftarrow \text{counter} + 1
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Monitor validation loss at each completed epoch
2. Reset patience counter and save checkpoint whenever loss improves by at least min_delta
3. Halt training when patience counter reaches threshold limit

### Returns
Dictionary with 'best_epoch', 'best_loss', 'stopped_epoch', and 'stopped_early'.
